headline: Sep 12 PM · The stack has gone fully silent, and silence is not a fix. The hourly Meta→CRM spend-sync alarm's last heartbeat was Sep 11 13:32Z — about 24 hours with no failure and no success notice — while the AI watchdog and daily digest stay dark from the Claude-credit blackout (nothing since Sep 10 17:06Z). Underneath it, the one fact that is not a bug: Mary Grossman's callback window passed with no recorded outcome, so the first real lead may have gone uncalled. Compliance 0/7, day 16.

spotlight.title: Mary Grossman's window passed — write the outcome down
spotlight.detail: The first real lead the $300 Plan produced (NV) asked for a call Fri 6:45 PM PT; that window has now closed. Across the whole mailbox there is no confirmation, no reply from her, no booking and no note from anyone that she was called, referred or deliberately held — so this is a miss on the record, not a pending task. She carries NO TCPA consent, so she can only be hand-dialled at +1 805 302 2655. The board has asked three mornings running for one thing: the decision — called / referred / held — written into a lane today.

spotlight.title: The whole stack is dark — don't read quiet as success
spotlight.detail: The AI lanes (FA-ADS watchdog, daily digest) have been silent since Sep 10 17:06Z / the Sep 11 15:00Z digest — the Claude-credit blackout takes out the interpreters and leaves the alarms. The plain-HTTP Meta→CRM spend sync then failed 14× (Sep 11 00:32→13:32Z, 403 egress-allowlist block) and simply stopped: no 15th failure and no success notice, which this pipeline has never emitted. The quiet is genuinely ambiguous. One-minute disproof (w30): open the CRM and look for spend rows timestamped after Sep 11 13:32Z — prove it landed, do not infer it from the silence. No 'credits restored' mail exists.

spotlight.title: Frozen scoreboard, compliance 0/7 on day 16
spotlight.detail: The Sep 11 digest read 0 new / 0 booked / 3 SLA breached / 0% booking / 135-min median reply — digit-for-digit identical to Sep 10. Three days, one real lead, zero bookings, and that lead may have gone uncalled. The deciding metric — cost per booked call — has been unmeasurable since Aug 27 because the CRM feed keeps failing. Compliance is unchanged at 0/7 on day 16 of live consumer lead flow (b3 TX telephone-solicitor reg, b7 CA producer license #); no statute re-verified this run.
